FROSTFALLEN CR 15
Large Undead 13,000xp
EE ——— |
_ AC 18 (frozen hide), HP 225 (18d10+126), Spd 40ft. climb |

20ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA |
22 (+6) 14(+2) 24 (+7) 5(3) 14(+2) 8 (1)

Eee

| Damage Vulnerabilities Fire, Radiant |
Damage Immunities cold, poison
Condition Immunities charmed, exhaustion, poisoned
Senses darkvision 120ft., blindsight 10ft. passive Perception 12 |
Languages That which it knew in life. |
Aura of Bitter Cold The Frostfallen radiates a supernatural cold |

emanation in a 30-foot radius. A creature of its choice |
starting its turn within the aura takes 11 (2d10) cold
damage. A creature grappled by the Devourer instead takes

22 (4d10) cold damage. |

Deathly Grip The Frostfallen can grapple and move up to two |
creatures simultaneously. It needn't spend extra movement
to move creatures it is grappling.

Frozen Flesh The Frostfallen ignores difficult terrain caused by |
ice or snow.

Eee |

|

Multiattack The Frostfallen makes two Claw attacks and one
Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Freezing
Embrace if available. |

| Claw MWA: +10, 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage, plus |

5 (1d10) cold damage, and on a successful hit can use both
the Damage and the Grapple option (Escape 18).

Bite MWA: +10, 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, plus 9 |
(2d8) cold damage. Additionally, if the target is grappled by |
the Frostfallen, add an additional 11 (2d10) cold damage.

Freezing Embrace (Recharge 5-6) The Frostfallen tightens its
grip around one creature it is grappling and encases it in
frost. That creature saves Constitution DC 18. Failure: it

takes an initial 33 (6d10) cold damage and gets the

restrained condition until the grapple ends. While restrained |
in this manner, the creature cannot speak above a whisper or
cast spells with a verbal component. Success: Takes half
damage and is not restrained.

REACTIONS

Desperate Clutch Trigger: A creature the Frostfallen can see |
within 10 ft. attempts to move away from it. Response: Make
a grapple attack against that creature (Escape 18).
